game.name: Mario Kart Wii
game.rules:
# Timing

- IGT (in-game time) and RTA (real time) are used to track times on the leaderboard.
- The leaderboard is sorted by IGT.

# Real Time

- RTA timing begins when "OK" is selected from the course selection screen.
- RTA timing ends on when you cross the finish line of the last course.
- The timer may not be paused.
- RTA time is required with every submission.
- Don't include milliseconds with the RTA time in your submission

# In-game time

- IGT is calculated by adding together each course's time as displayed on the in-game timer after crossing the finish line. Use [this tool](https://claabs.github.io/mkwii-igt-calc/) to calculate IGT easily.
- A video is required to submit IGT. IGT on a video-less run will be removed.
- IGT requires milliseconds.
- Intentionally pausing the game mid-race is not allowed.
- To discourage excessive inactivity, extra idle time between races is limited to a maximum of 5 seconds per track total throughout the run. Example: for a 32 track run you get 2 minutes 40 seconds (5 seconds x 32 tracks) of idle time that may be distributed however necessary throughout the run.

# Platform Rules

- Wii and WiiU loaded from a game disc are allowed.
- Emulator (Dolphin) is banned.
- SD card/USB ISO loaders are banned.
- No Ocarina/Gecko/Action Replay codes (obviously).
- CTGP is allowed according to the rules in the next section.

# CTGP Rules

Note that while using CTGP, Ultra Shortcuts are patched, so don't use it for "Skips" categories.
CTGP may have increased load times over vanilla MKWii, you will probably lose time in RTA based runs (100%).

Page 1

- Custom Tracks: OFF
- Remove Game Music?: NO
- 'My Stuff' Folder: OFF
- Save game on SD card?: NO
- Special Fonts: OFF

Page 2

- SD Compatible Mode: OFF

Page 3

- Item Rain (Offline): OFF
- All Items Can Land (Offline): OFF
- 200cc (Offline): Off
- Enable Beta Features: NO (Only if on 24 Players Beta)
- Long Distance Names: Off
- Menu Transition Speed: Normal

# Video Requirements

- Video proof is required if your RTA time is equal to or faster than the time specified in the category rules.
- Your in-game timer should be in frame and readable at the end of each race.

# FAQs

Learn and ask new questions about the rules in [this thread](https://www.speedrun.com/mkw/thread/5qbcz/1#kpq4w).
